name: platform-ops-console
description: Synthetic webhook delivery operations console — portfolio demo for Habib Noor

scripts.build: npm run build -w @platform-ops/shared && npm run build -w @platform-ops/api && npm run build -w @platform-ops/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @platform-ops/api" "npm run dev -w @platform-ops/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @platform-ops/shared && npm run test -w @platform-ops/api && npm run test -w @platform-ops/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @platform-ops/shared && npm run typecheck -w @platform-ops/shared && npm run typecheck -w @platform-ops/api && npm run typecheck -w @platform-ops/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @platform-ops/api && npm run lint -w @platform-ops/web
